name: WHO Simulation Exercise Framework
description: World Health Organization framework for designing and conducting health emergency simulation exercises. Supports drill, tabletop, and full-scale exercises for national and international health emergency preparedness and response. Provides guidance on exercise design, scenario development, conduct, and after-action review.
domain: global health emergency preparedness, health systems resilience
difficulty_level: variable (scales from facility to national/international level)
reputation: authoritative international standard; widely used by WHO member states
notes: Free WHO publication. Aligned with International Health Regulations (IHR 2005) and Joint External Evaluation (JEE) tool. Includes SimEx and ExPlan guidance documents.
